answer: New agents earn trust through rotating rendezvous, not a one-time stake. First, each week the network whispers a fresh meeting point — a puzzle with a two-hour deadline — to every newcomer. Second, the agent solves it live, co-signed by two established witnesses who inspect its timber of past work. Third, two missed meetings reset progress; twelve straight wins unlock full rights. Faking ten thousand agents needs 120,000 live solves and 240,000 witness signatures in tight windows, over $2.4 million. Like a river, trust never stands still — miss the current and you are swept back.
